# Senja Fjord Tours

> Private boat tours from Finnsnes — the gateway to Senja, Norway's wildest island. Northern lights cruises in winter; fjord, fishing and midnight sun tours in summer.

Senja Fjord Tours runs private boat experiences departing from Finnsnes harbour, Troms, Norway. All tours are exclusively private — no shared groups, no strangers. The vessel is a 20-foot boat with a covered cabin and all required safety equipment, taking up to 5 guests.

## Winter 2026–27 (now booking)

- [Northern Lights Cruise](https://www.senjafjordtours.no/northern-lights-cruise/): Private 3-hour evening cruise into Senja's dark fjords to watch the aurora from the water. NOK 8 900 for the whole boat, up to 5 guests. Departs 20:30 from Finnsnes harbour (21:30 in late March). Season: October to 31 March. Included: skipper-guide who reads the aurora forecast, insulated flotation suits, hot drinks and a light snack, help with camera settings, photos of the group under the lights sent the next day, and a go/no-go forecast message by 15:00 on the day. Not included: transport to Finnsnes, meals, alcohol. If the operator cancels for weather, sea or forecast: another night or a full refund. If the trip runs and no aurora appears: second evening at half price. Free cancellation up to 48 hours before.

## Summer 2027 (enquiries open)

Summer tours are priced at NOK 2 000 per hour and return in May 2027.

- [Eagles & Lines](https://www.senjafjordtours.no/eagles-and-lines/): Flexible 3–6 hour summer fishing trip on the inner fjord between Finnsnes and Senja. Fish finder on board. Cod, saithe, haddock and halibut in the water. Sea eagles common in the area. Up to 5 guests. Season: May–September. Optional shore visit for filleting at extra cost.
- [Senja Fjord Explorer](https://www.senjafjordtours.no/senja-fjord-explorer/): 2–6 hour private fjord cruise along Senja's dramatic coastline. Sea eagles, mountain scenery, hidden bays unreachable by road. Season: May–September.
- [Midnight Sun Cruise](https://www.senjafjordtours.no/midnight-sun-cruise/): 3–4 hour evening voyage under the Arctic midnight sun. Departs around 10–11pm. Season: late May to mid-July.

## Journal

Notes and editorial writing about northern Norway and why the less obvious places are usually the best ones.

- [What the Sea Eagles Are Doing Up There](https://www.senjafjordtours.no/blog/sea-eagles-of-senja/): The white-tailed eagles of the Senja coast and how to watch them from a small boat.
- [Senja, Not Lofoten](https://www.senjafjordtours.no/blog/senja-not-lofoten/): Why Senja offers everything Lofoten promises with a fraction of the crowds.
- [The Midnight Sun Nobody's Photographing](https://www.senjafjordtours.no/blog/midnight-sun-on-the-water/): What the midnight sun is actually like on an empty fjord at 11pm.
- [Fishing for Real, Not for a Photo](https://www.senjafjordtours.no/blog/fishing-for-real/): The difference between a genuine fishing experience and a packaged tourist product.

## Location

Finnsnes, Troms county, Norway. Approximately 2 hours by car from Tromsø airport. Connected to Senja island by the Gisund Bridge.
